symbols.name: linear map
symbols.meaning: A linear map from one finite-dimensional complex vector space to another, whose operator norm is taken.
symbols.quote: Let $\Phi$ be a linear map from one finite-dimensional complex vector space to another, each with a chosen vector norm $\|\cdot\|$.

symbols.name: input vector
symbols.meaning: A vector in the domain of the linear map, over which the supremum defining the operator norm ranges.
symbols.quote: Write $\xi$ for a vector in the domain of $\Phi$.
